name: yzzx-content-studio
description: Multi-IP MCN content studio for Hong Kong insurance self-media: mines insurance knowledge from ima, matches each IP's positioning with high-traffic topics, produces a checkable 8-topic page with 5 angles each, then writes voiceover scripts capped at 700 characters, runs compliance review and generates publishing packages.

displayDescription.en: Learn insurance from ima + mine trends into a checkable 8-topic page with 5 angles, then ≤700-character scripts and a publishing kit in 30 min. | v2.11.0
